title: SPY Weekly Report — Week of Oct 12–16, 2026
html:
Live version (with chart): Claude Doc

Bottom line

SPY closed at $763.25, down 1.7% on the week and 2.0% below its Oct 6 record close, as an AI-chip selloff collided with $100+ oil and a hot inflation print. A rotation, not a rout: Dow +0.7%, Nasdaq −4.5%; energy, utilities and staples up as tech sank.

House view: cautious next 3–4 weeks, constructive on 12 months. Street sees SPX 7,400–8,100 at year-end. Path runs through the Oct 28 Fed meeting, mega-cap earnings and the Nov 3 midterms. Changes the view: SPY above $779 → constructive; below $760.64 → opens ~$750.

Hedge funds & flows

Hedge funds net sold AI stocks Oct 8–14; Oct 15 every strategy fell >0.8%. $166.4B into money funds week to Oct 7 (most since Apr 2020). Hartnett risk-off 3–4 weeks. MU + NVDA = 36% of expected Q3 earnings growth. See Hedge Funds & Flows.
